title: Ticket
about: A printed card ticket with the company's name, a serial number and a perforated stub; it prints on a white page, ready to cut out.

fields.prop_line_name: The company or line that issued it, across the top, e.g. Halvard & Northern Railway
fields.prop_serial: The serial number, on the ticket and its stub, e.g. No 004127
fields.prop_class: The class or kind of ticket, e.g. Second Class
